system.description:
Size: Small or Medium (your choice) | Weight Class: 4

Gain 4 Mastery Points to put into Aggression, Endurance, Strength, Survival, Nimbleness or Wisdom as you see fit. Your Talents still have a maximum of 5.

Gain 2 Mastery Points to put into your Sight Sense or Hearing Sense as you see fit.
